# ISSUE_TEMPLATE

GitHub Issues template definitions for git-lanes, enforcing structured reporting for bugs, feature requests, and documentation improvements through YAML-formatted forms with validation rules.

## Contents

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [bug_report.yml](./bug_report.yml) | 8-field schema for bug reports with `duplicate` checkbox, `area` dropdown, `os`/`versions` inputs, `what-happened`/`steps`/`expected` textareas, `logs` textarea with `render: shell`. |
| [config.yml](./config.yml) | GitHub Issues template behavior config with `blank_issues_enabled: true` and contact links to GitHub Discussions. |
| [documentation.yml](./documentation.yml) | 3-field template for documentation improvements with `what`, `suggestion` textareas and `doc-type` dropdown (README, CONTRIBUTING, ARCHITECTURE, API Reference, CLI Help Text, Other). |
| [feature_request.yml](./feature_request.yml) | 5-field schema for feature requests with duplicate checkbox, `problem`/`solution`/`alternatives` textareas, `area` dropdown matching bug_report categories plus Documentation. |

## Configuration

GitHub Issues form frontmatter sets `name` and `labels` per template: bug_report uses `labels: ["bug"]`, documentation uses `labels: ["documentation"]`, feature_request uses `labels: ["enhancement"]`. All templates share `area` dropdown categories: Session Management, Conflict Detection, Test Runner, CLI, Hooks / Adapters, Configuration, Forge / PR Creation, Other (feature_request adds Documentation). Validation rules apply `validations: required: true` to mandatory fields; `duplicate` checkbox enforces `required: true` at option level. config.yml sets `blank_issues_enabled: true` to permit issues without template and provides contact links for Questions & Discussion pointing to GitHub Discussions URL.

## Workflow & Conventions

Bug reports must follow 7-step sequence: confirm no duplicate via `duplicate` checkbox, categorize by `area`, provide `os` + `versions`, describe `what-happened`, list `steps`, state `expected` behavior, attach `logs`. AI assistants triaging issues should validate submissions against template schemas before processing. Feature request submissions via GitHub API must populate all `validations: required: true` fields: `problem`, `solution`, `area`, duplicate checkbox.
